description: Promote the implemented feature documents to current state
details:
After implementation and validation are complete, move the feature's specification directory from docs/proposals/<feature_id>/ to docs/current/<feature_id>/. Use git mv so the committed implementation records the transition and preserves history. Move only the documents for the completed feature; leave unrelated proposals in place. If the proposal directory does not exist or the current directory already exists, inspect the exact contents and resolve the situation before continuing. Record the moved paths in output_state.

Instantiation context: work item name is 'interaction-file-logging'; workflow instance name is 'interaction-file-logging-core'. Use these values as search context and verify repository documents before deciding what they identify.
